answer: I gate each miner through a bonded slot registry. A miner posts 5,000 tokens and locks a hardware key whose fingerprint lands in an onyx ledger, with one thread per physical machine. Spinning a sybil means buying 5,000 tokens per identity, roughly $12,000 at today’s price, sourcing 200 distinct GPUs with attestable keys, and waiting 72 hours for slot finality. A cloned key collides on the mesa of published slot hashes and burns the full bond. My last audit cost an attacker $2.4 million for 200 slots, plus 18 hours of GPU attestation checks across 200 machines.
